metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Vietnam between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collections: Use MODIS Thermal Anomalies 8-day composites: MODIS/061/MOD14A1 (Terra) and MODIS/061/MYD14A1 (Aqua). If empty, fallback to 006 versions.
- Date: 2016-08-01 to 2018-02-28.
- Location: Country polygons for Cambodia and Vietnam from USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017; fallback to FAO/GAUL/2015/level0 if needed.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Not a cloud question. Use FireMask band; consider active fire pixels as FireMask >= 4 (low, nominal, high confidence fires).
- Create binary images per 8-day composite, sum across time to get detection counts per pixel, then sum over country.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection sizes; if zero even after fallback => C1.
- Compute valid pixel counts from the summed image; if zero => C2.
- If any reduceRegion outputs null/NaN => C3.
- Catch exceptions (bad IDs, memory) => D.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    var start = '2016-08-01';
    var end = '2018-02-28';
    var scale = 2000; // meters
    
    // Load country geometries (primary: LSIB, fallback: GAUL)
    function getCountryGeomLSIB(name) {
      var fc = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
        .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', name));
      return fc.size().gt(0).divide(1).expression('g', {'g': fc.size()})
        ? fc.geometry()
        : null;
    }
    function getCountryGeomGAUL(name) {
      var fc = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0')
        .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', name));
      return fc.size().gt(0).divide(1).expression('g', {'g': fc.size()})
        ? fc.geometry()
        : null;
    }
    function pickCountryGeom(preferredNameLSIB, altNameGAUL) {
      var g1 = getCountryGeomLSIB(preferredNameLSIB);
      var geom = ee.Algorithms.If(g1, g1, getCountryGeomGAUL(altNameGAUL));
      return ee.Geometry(geom);
    }
    var cambodia = pickCountryGeom('Cambodia', 'Cambodia');
    var vietnam = pickCountryGeom('Vietnam', 'Viet Nam');

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    function getModisFireCollections() {
      var terraId = 'MODIS/061/MOD14A1';
      var aquaId = 'MODIS/061/MYD14A1';
      var terra = ee.ImageCollection(terraId).filterDate(start, end);
      var aqua = ee.ImageCollection(aquaId).filterDate(start, end);
      var sizes = ee.Dictionary({
        terra: terra.size(),
        aqua: aqua.size(),
        terraId: terraId,
        aquaId: aquaId
      });
      return sizes;
    }
    function getModisFireCollectionsFallback() {
      var terraId = 'MODIS/006/MOD14A1';
      var aquaId = 'MODIS/006/MYD14A1';
      var terra = ee.ImageCollection(terraId).filterDate(start, end);
      var aqua = ee.ImageCollection(aquaId).filterDate(start, end);
      var sizes = ee.Dictionary({
        terra: terra.size(),
        aqua: aqua.size(),
        terraId: terraId,
        aquaId: aquaId
      });
      return sizes;
    }

    var sizes061 = getModisFireCollections();
    var terra061Size = await sizes061.get('terra').getInfo();
    var aqua061Size = await sizes061.get('aqua').getInfo();
    var terraId = await sizes061.get('terraId').getInfo();
    var aquaId = await sizes061.get('aquaId').getInfo();

    var use006Fallback = false;
    if ((terra061Size === 0) && (aqua061Size === 0)) {
      var sizes006 = getModisFireCollectionsFallback();
      var terra006Size = await sizes006.get('terra').getInfo();
      var aqua006Size = await sizes006.get('aqua').getInfo();
      terraId = await sizes006.get('terraId').getInfo();
      aquaId = await sizes006.get('aquaId').getInfo();
      use006Fallback = true;
      if ((terra006Size === 0) && (aqua006Size === 0)) {
        console.log(`Date: ${start} to ${end}`);
        console.log(`Terra images: 0`);
        console.log(`Aqua images: 0`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    var terraCol = ee.ImageCollection(terraId).filterDate(start, end);
    var aquaCol = ee.ImageCollection(aquaId).filterDate(start, end);
    var terraSize = await terraCol.size().getInfo();
    var aquaSize = await aquaCol.size().getInfo();

    // 3. Processing
    // Binary fire mask per image: FireMask >= 4 (low, nominal, high confidence)
    function toBinary(img) {
      return img.select('FireMask').gt(3).rename('fire');
    }
    var terraBinSum = terraCol.map(toBinary).sum().rename('fire');
    var aquaBinSum = aquaCol.map(toBinary).sum().rename('fire');
    var totalBinSum = terraBinSum.add(aquaBinSum).rename('fire');

    // Valid pixel count (any unmasked pixel in summed image) per country
    function statsForCountry(geom) {
      var opts = {reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e10};
      var countOpts = {reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e10};
      var terraSum = terraBinSum.reduceRegion(opts).get('fire');
      var aquaSum = aquaBinSum.reduceRegion(opts).get('fire');
      var totalSum = totalBinSum.reduceRegion(opts).get('fire');
      var validPix = totalBinSum.reduceRegion(countOpts).get('fire');
      return ee.Dictionary({
        terra: terraSum,
        aqua: aquaSum,
        total: totalSum,
        valid: validPix
      });
    }

    var camStats = statsForCountry(cambodia);
    var vieStats = statsForCountry(vietnam);

    var camTerra = await camStats.get('terra').getInfo();
    var camAqua = await camStats.get('aqua').getInfo();
    var camTotal = await camStats.get('total').getInfo();
    var camValid = await camStats.get('valid').getInfo();

    var vieTerra = await vieStats.get('terra').getInfo();
    var vieAqua = await vieStats.get('aqua').getInfo();
    var vieTotal = await vieStats.get('total').getInfo();
    var vieValid = await vieStats.get('valid').getInfo();

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer determination
    // Check for valid pixels
    if ((camValid === 0 || camValid === null) && (vieValid === 0 || vieValid === null)) {
      console.log(`Date: ${start} to ${end}`);
      console.log(`Terra images: ${terraSize} ${use006Fallback ? '(C006)' : '(C061)'}`);
      console.log(`Aqua images: ${aquaSize} ${use006Fallback ? '(C006)' : '(C061)'}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels in both countries after processing.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    // Check for calculation failures (null/NaN)
    function invalid(v) { return v === null || (typeof v === 'number' && !isFinite(v)); }
    if (invalid(camTotal) || invalid(vieTotal)) {
      console.log('Calculation failed (null/NaN).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Print concise evidence (<=20 lines) and final answer
    console.log(`Date: ${start} to ${end}, Scale: ${scale} m`);
    console.log(`Terra images: ${terraSize} ${use006Fallback ? '(C006)' : '(C061)'}`);
    console.log(`Aqua images: ${aquaSize} ${use006Fallback ? '(C006)' : '(C061)'}`);
    console.log(`Cambodia - Detections (Terra/Aqua/Total): ${Math.round(camTerra||0)}/${Math.round(camAqua||0)}/${Math.round(camTotal||0)}; Valid px: ${Math.round(camValid||0)}`);
    console.log(`Vietnam  - Detections (Terra/Aqua/Total): ${Math.round(vieTerra||0)}/${Math.round(vieAqua||0)}/${Math.round(vieTotal||0)}; Valid px: ${Math.round(vieValid||0)}`);

    if (camTotal > vieTotal) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
